module: Shared English corner numbering in three levels: hard, medium, easy. Each level gives the spoken text, the measured physical diameter range (m) and the visual (corner icon, colors). Used by the english/casual style.
notes: Diameter ranges: hard [0, 65[, medium [65, 190[, easy [190, +inf[; they correspond to the turn1, turn3 and turn6 icons.
No lengthsByIntensity: this system defines no lengths.
The module returns the table {id, intensity} directly; ranges can be recalibrated per mission via calibrationOverrides.

intensity.desc: Three entries {id, text, diameter={min,max}, visual={icon, text, colorBg, colorStroke, ...}}, from the tightest (hard, red) to the most open (easy, green).
